high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a dressing room or a similar indoor space. The individual is wearing a blue button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows and dark blue jeans. They have their left hand in their pocket and are holding a smartphone in their right hand, which they are using to take the photo. The background features a white door with a silver handle and a small section of a white wall above it. There is a white coat rack with four hooks mounted on the wall, but no coats are hanging from them.
